thread:
customer_acme_ops: Hey team — noticed a spike in latency since yesterday ~12:30 UTC. Requests from our app (US clients) are being routed to EU and we're seeing +300–400ms p99 and extra egress charges. We set region in the SDK to 'us-east'. Can you help?
customer_acme_ops: Repro curl: 
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=us-east' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' -H 'X-Redwood-Region: ' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
customer_acme_ops: Note the X-Redwood-Region header is empty in our telemetry (looks like SDK sets it but leaves value blank).
sara_support: Thanks — can you paste SDK version and a sample request id if you have one? Also any timestamps from your traces?
customer_acme_ops: SDK v1.2.3. Sample request id: req_2027-03-15_16:27:03_abc123. Traces show upstream node: routing -> region=eu-west-1, not us-east.
raj_eng: I can reproduce locally with the same SDK. Looks like the router prioritizes the header over query param. Empty header string currently considered "present" and overrides the query param. That's wrong.
maya_infra: We rolled a small routing change last week (1799900100) that tightened header precedence. Logs show: "region header present but empty -> use header". I'll dig into who added that check.
liam_product: This matches a couple other reports but they were quieter. Impact: wrong region + cross-region egress + higher latency. Good catch, thanks.
sara_support: For immediate mitigation, customer can either remove the header or set it explicitly to 'us-east' (non-empty).
raj_eng: We'll patch router to ignore empty/whitespace region headers and fall back to query param/token/route policy. Short-term fix: add header sanity check. Long-term: add a routing decision debug tag so we log which signal chosen.
deploy_bot: Deploy queued: ignore-empty-region-header fix -> canary support cluster (deploy_789) started
raj_eng: Patch includes: 
```
if region_header and region_header.strip():
  use header
else:
  skip header and continue
```
raj_eng: Also pushed a new SDK hotfix flagged 1.2.4 that sets header only if region config present (won't send empty). Recommend customers upgrade.
customer_acme_ops: Applied temporary remove-header workaround — traffic now goes to us-east and latency dropped to expected range. Thanks!
sara_support: I'll open a billing review for cross-region egress during the incident window. Please attach request ids if you want credit considered.
liam_product: Follow-ups: (1) track incidents caused by empty header as a category, (2) add an SDK test to prevent sending empty region header, (3) postmortem short note.
customer_acme_ops: Will upload sample request ids to the ticket. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
